def search_insert(nums, target):
    low = 0                         # left edge of the unresolved range
    high = len(nums)                # exclusive right edge; end insertion is valid

    while low < high:               # narrow the first value >= target
        mid = low + (high - low) // 2  # overflow-safe midpoint
        if nums[mid] < target:       # too small; discard this prefix
            low = mid + 1
        else:                        # candidate boundary; search for an earlier one
            high = mid

    return low                      # target index or insertion position
